**Product:** Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones - graphite

Here is the head-to-head:

| Feature | Seller A - Brackmoor Sound | Seller B - Ottervale Audio |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |

| **Stock / Shipping** | In stock. Free standard shipping, 3-5 business days | In stock. Free standard shipping, 3-5 business days |
| **Returns** | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty | 1-year limited warranty |
| **Specs / In the box** | Same - 40h battery, ANC, Bluetooth 5.3, carry case + cables | Same - 40h battery, ANC, Bluetooth 5.3, carry case + cables |

There is no objective advantage to one over the other based on what's on those pages. Same price, same shipping speed and cost, same return policy, same warranty, same rating.

You can buy from **either one** - pick whichever you prefer, or if you've bought from one of them before and had a good experience, go with that one.

If trustworthiness is a concern, you might want to quickly check external reviews for "Brackmoor Sound" vs "Ottervale Audio" outside of those listings, but from the information provided alone, they are indistinguishable.
